author: Matt Anderson, Andrew Schwartz
description: Detects when MsMpEng.exe (Microsoft Defender Antimalware Service) queries information about other processes. This is generally normal behavior for an antivirus but is provided as per specific request.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND (EventID=10 AND SourceImage LIKE '%\\MsMpEng.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetImage LIKE '%\\defendnot-loader.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND GrantedAccess='0x1000')
title: MsMpEng.exe Process Access defendnot loader

author: Huntress Labs
description: Detects the activity of a suspicious child spawning from Windows Update Service (WSUS), potential CVE-2025-59287.
falsepositives: Should be low false positivies... nothing should spawn from wsusservice.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (`process.parent.pe.original_file_name`='wsusservice.exe' OR (`process.parent.pe.original_file_name`='w3wp.exe' AND `process.parent.command_line` LIKE '%wsuspool%' ESCAPE '\' AND `process.name`='cmd.exe')))
title: Suspicious Windows Update Service Child

author: Chad Hudson, Matt Anderson
description: Detects Javaw spawning suspicious powershell commands. This has been observed as possible post-exploitation activity of Cleo software.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\javaw.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -nop%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -noni%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -NonInteractive%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -w hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -windowstyle hidden%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%(New-Object Net.WebClient).Download%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -EncodedCommand %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Javaw Spawning Suspicious Powershell Commands

author: Craig Sweeney
description: Detects the use of Nslookup to enumerate mail servers while using a shortened query type parameter “-q”
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%’\\nslookup.exe’' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%‘-q=mx’%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Mail Exchanger Enumeration via Nslookup with a Shortened Query Parameter

author: Craig Sweeney, Matt Anderson
description: Detects Mesh Agent, the client software used to connect to a Mesh Central Server
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (Product='’MeshCentral Agent’' OR Description='MeshCentral Background Service Agent'))
title: Mesh Agent Execution

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detects the use of powershell commands from headless conhost window. The "--headless" flag hides the windows from the user upon execution.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--headless%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Powershell From Headless Conhost

author: Matt Anderson, Craig Sweeney (Huntress)
description: Detects the use of winrar.exe commands to recurse subfolders. This may indicate a threat actor looking to archive all files within a directory without specificity, which is highly uncommon.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Winrar command line version
Other command line tools or software that use these flags
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rar.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\winrar.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='WinRAR.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -r%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% a %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Create WinRAR Archive - Recurse Subfolders

author: Huntress DE&TH Team
description: Detects PowerShell reverse shell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%net.sockets.tcpclient%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%io.streamwriter%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%net.sockets.tcpclient%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%getstream%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Pwsh-reverse-shell

author: Tyler Bohlmann, Andrew Schwartz, Matt Anderson
description: Detects the execution of defendnot-loader.exe.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\defendnot-loader.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%defendnot-loader.exe%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: defendnot Execution

author: Craig Sweeney, Matt Anderson, Jose Oregon, Tim Kasper, Faith Stratton, Samantha Shaw
description: Detects execution of a shell process with CrushFTP as a parent process. May indicate post-exploitation of a vulnerability in CrushFTP.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\crushftpservice.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Shell Process from CrushFTP

author: Craig Sweeney, Jai Minton, Michael Tigges, Matt Anderson, John Hammond (Huntress)
description: Detects execution of a shell process from the "Portal" Application Pool used by Gladinet Centrestack or the “Management” Application Pool used by Triofox, as a parent process. This may indicate successful exploitation of a vulnerability in Centrestack or Triofox.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\portal\\portal.config%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\management\\management.config%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Shell Process from Gladinet CentreStack or Triofox

author: Tyler Bohlmann, Andrew Schwartz, Matt Anderson
description: Detects two different types of Event 15 from SecurityCenter occurring within 5 seconds - one with STATE_OFF and another with STATE_ON
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Application' AND ((EventID=15 AND Source='SecurityCenter') AND (EventData LIKE '%SECURITY\_PRODUCT\_STATE\_OFF%' ESCAPE '\' OR (EventData LIKE '%SECURITY\_PRODUCT\_STATE\_ON%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventData LIKE '%https://github.com/es3n1n/defendnot%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: defendnot Windows Defender State Toggle Events

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detects when a user disables Defender settings via GUI.  This can be used by adversaries to impair defenses.
falsepositives: May be turned off by a user or admin for legitimate purposes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SystemSettingsAdminFlows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SystemSettingsAdminFlows.EXE') AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\SystemSettings.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Defender DisableEnhancedNotifications 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Defender SubmitSamplesConsent 0%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Defender SpynetReporting 0%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Defender RTP 1%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows Defender Threat Protection Settings Disabled via GUI

author: Craig Sweeney, Anna Pham, Michael Tigges, Matt Anderson, Andrew Schwartz (Huntress)
description: Detects execution of a Cmd process from a parent Node Process, with a suspicious enumeration or output command such as "whoami" or "systeminfo". This is a possible indication of exploitation of Meta React Server Components vulnerability identified as CVE-2025-55182, "React2Shell".
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%whoami%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%systeminfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%quser%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%echo%' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\nodejs\\node.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Command from Node.Js

author: Alden Schmidt, Matt Anderson
description: Detects when a user disables Defender settings without using the Settings GUI.  This can be used by adversaries to impair defenses.
falsepositives: May be turned off by a user or admin for legitimate purposes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SystemSettingsAdminFlows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SystemSettingsAdminFlows.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Defender DisableEnhancedNotifications 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Defender SubmitSamplesConsent 0%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Defender SpynetReporting 0%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Defender RTP 1%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\SystemSettings.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Windows Defender Threat Protection Settings Disabled

author: Huntress Team
description: Detects Tar.exe being used to extract a file to a specified location via the "-xf" flag to extract files and the "-C" flag to specify the target directory.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName='bsdtar' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-xf%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-C%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Tar Archive Extraction to Specified Location

author: Tyler Bohlmann, Andrew Schwartz, Matt Anderson
description: Detects taskmgr.exe child process spawning from defendnot-loader.exe execution.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\defendnot-loader.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\taskmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Taskmgr Child Process of defendnot

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detect use of processes with no name (".exe"), which can be used to evade Image-based detections.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%.exe' ESCAPE '\')
title: Process with No Name

author: Huntress DE&TH Team
description: Detects suspicious Rundll32 WebDAV client execution with observed .WAV artifact added to the UNC path. The .WAV is associated with the value stored in the PidLidReminderFileParameter which determines the audio tone to use in a missed meeting or overdue task. The UNC path in the attack forces the victim machine to look for the file on a remote server where the victim machine attempts to authenticate -- subsequently leaking NTLM hashes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\windows\\system32\\davclnt.dll,DavSetCookie%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.WAV%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Possible CVE-2023-23397

author: Tyler Bohlmann (Huntress)
description: Detects the use of bcdedit.exe to disable the Early Launch Antimalware (ELAM) drivers. Early launch anti-malware (ELAM) provides protection for the computers in your network when they start up and before third-party drivers initialize. Malicious software can load as a driver or rootkits might attack before the operating system completely loads.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bcdedit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='bcdedit.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%{current}%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%disableelamdrivers%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%yes%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Disabling ELAM drivers via BCDEdit.exe

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detects DlpUserAgent.exe (Microsoft Defender Data Loss Prevention User Agent) running from an unusual or unknown directory, which may be indicative of DLL Side-Loading. This binary legitimately resides within the Windows Defender directory and has been observed being abused by threat actors to sideload malicious DLLs delivering C2 payloads such as Havoc.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName='DlpUserAgent.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Possible DLL Side-Loading Using DlpUserAgent.exe

author: Matt Anderson
description: Detects creation of scheduled tasks potentially used for autorun persistence (Event ID 4698), such as those created by defendnot or similar tooling.
falsepositives: Legitimate admin tasks with similar names or command lines
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4698 AND (TaskName LIKE '%defendnot%' ESCAPE '\' OR TaskName LIKE '%autorun%' ESCAPE '\' OR TaskName LIKE '%Loader%' ESCAPE '\') AND (TaskContent LIKE '%defendnot%' ESCAPE '\' OR TaskContent LIKE '%--from-autorun%' ESCAPE '\' OR TaskContent LIKE '%defendnot-loader%' ESCAPE '\' OR TaskContent LIKE '%\\defendnot.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Defendnot Scheduled Task Creation - Security

description: Detects processes spawning from tomcat located in the GoAnywhere folder
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Goanywhere\\tomcat\\bin\\tomcat.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Process Spawned From GoAnywhere Tomcat

author: Craig Sweeney, Tanner Filip, Matt Anderson, John Hammond (Huntress)
description: Detects execution of a command shell with Wing FTP Server as a Parent Process.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wftpserver.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Command Shell from Wing FTP Server

author: Huntress DE&TH Team
description: Detects suspicious code execution from vulnerable PaperCut versions MF and NG
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pc-app.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PaperCut MF/NG Vulnerability

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detects a command line that names the WinRing0 vulnerable driver alongside a URL. Cryptominer droppers fetch WinRing0x64.sys next to the miner so it can tune CPU registers, while hardware monitoring tools ship the driver inside their installers rather than downloading it on its own. Look for a miner binary and config.json downloaded to the same directory and a service created to run it.
falsepositives: Administrators manually fetching a hardware-monitoring driver
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%winring0%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: WinRing0 Driver Downloaded via Command Line

author: Matt Anderson, Craig Sweeney (Huntress)
description: Detects the use of winrar.exe commands to create an archive with a specific volume size. This may indicate a threat actor increasing the size of the volume to prevent making separate files.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Winrar command line version
Other command line tools or software that use these flags
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rar.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\winrar.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='WinRAR.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -v%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% a %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Create WinRAR Archive - Specify Volume Size

author: Tyler Bohlmann (Huntress)
description: Detects a PowerShell ScriptBlock that watches for Task Manager and stops or starts a service depending on whether it is open. Cryptominer operators use this pattern to hide the miner service from users who go looking for high CPU usage. Check the ScriptBlock for the service name and look for that service's binary path and creation event.
falsepositives: Administrative scripts that coordinate service state with Task Manager
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%taskmgr%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Stop-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-Service%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PowerShell Scriptblock - Task Manager Aware Service Control

author: Tyler Bohlmann, Andrew Schwartz, Matt Anderson
description: Detects the update of the default scheduled task creation of defendnot after binary execution.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4702 AND (TaskContentNew LIKE '%defendnot%' ESCAPE '\' AND TaskContentNew LIKE '%--from-autorun%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Updated Default defendnot Scheduled Task

description: Detects suspicious Qakbot execution activity, observed on february 2023.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%exported%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%open.cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%GoodOldFile.bat%' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ProgramData%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%public%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\t.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%Public%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Qakbot Execution (Rundll32/Powershell) - Feb 2023

author: Huntress Team
description: Detects deployment and execution of Zoho ManageEngine RMM tools (ToolsIQ.exe) following potential SolarWinds Web Help Desk compromise. This legitimate RMM tool has been abused by threat actors for remote control.
falsepositives: Authorized deployment of ManageEngine RMM in the environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ToolsIQ.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\ToolsIQ.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\WebHelpDesk\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Exploitation - Zoho ManageEngine RMM Deployment

author: Huntress DE&TH Team
description: MOVEitTransfer is affected by a critical vulnerability CVE-2023-34362. Exploited hosts show evidence of dynamically compliling a DLL, which then executes a script (file path for this temp file is C:\Windows\TEMP\[random]\[random].cmdline) to create a webshell that so far has always been named 'human2.aspx'. The filepaths 'c:\moveittransfer\wwwroot' and 'C:\Windows\Microsoft\.NET\Framework64\v4\.0\.30319\Temporary ASP\.NET Files\root' should be investigated for recently modified files. Evidence of exploitation can also be found on the webserver logs for the MOVEit Transfer application.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%moveitdmz pool%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\csc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Windows\\temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: MOVEit exploitation CVE-2023-34362

author: Matt Anderson, Dray Agha, Anna Pham (Huntress)
description: Detects execution of devcon.exe with commands that disable the VMware Virtual Machine Communication Interface (VMCI) device. This can be legitimate during VMware Tools troubleshooting or driver conflicts, but may also indicate malware attempting to hijack communication with the hardware via the VMCI device. This has been used to facilitate VMware ESXi vulnerability exploits to escape VMs and execute code on the ESXi host.
falsepositives: Legitimate VMware administration, Tools installation/uninstallation, or troubleshooting driver conflicts
Automated scripts in virtualized environments for device cleanup
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\devcon.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% disable %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%15AD&DEV\_0740%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%VMWVMCIHOSTDEV%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Devcon Execution Disabling VMware VMCI Device

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detects the use of a CMSTPLUA elevated COM Interface to execute a system binary that can be used for proxy execution. Using this COM Interface bypasses UAC, and has been used by numerous threat actors to execute ransomware and other malware.
falsepositives: Some legitimate applications may use this occasionally
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%Processid:{3E5FC7F9-9A51-4367-9063-A120244FBEC7}%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\hh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\control.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmstp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\installutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvcs.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regasm.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\verclsid.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mavinject.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: System Binary Proxy Execution Using CMSTPLUA COM Interface

author: Matt Anderson, Andrew Schwartz, Tyler Bohlmann
description: Detects image load events (DLLs or modules) by taskmgr.exe (Windows Task Manager) in Sysmon logs from non-standard directories with unsigned modules or invalid signatures, indicating potential malicious activity such as DLL injection.  Used by Defendnot evasion tool that disables Windows Defender.
falsepositives: Legitimate third-party tools or extensions loading unsigned or invalidly signed DLLs from non-standard directories
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND ((EventID=7 AND Image LIKE '%\\taskmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ImageLoaded LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImageLoaded LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImageLoaded LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImageLoaded LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImageLoaded LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\com\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImageLoaded LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\en-US\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND ((Signed='false' OR Signed=0) OR (SignatureStatus LIKE '%Invalid%' ESCAPE '\' OR SignatureStatus LIKE '%UntrustedRoot%' ESCAPE '\' OR SignatureStatus LIKE '%Expired%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Image Load into taskmgr.exe with Invalid or Unsigned Modules (Sysmon)

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detects the AhsayCBS backup server service, cbssvcX64.exe or cbssvcX86.exe, spawning a process outside its startup and maintenance baseline. AhsayCBS hosts its Tomcat web app in-process, so commands from an uploaded JSP webshell run as direct children of the service. Treat as webshell execution until disproven.
falsepositives: AhsayCBS releases that add new startup commands
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cbssvcX64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cbssvcX86.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\7za.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rotatelogs.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\java.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cbssvcX64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cbssvcX86.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine REGEXP '(?i)^("?([a-z]:\\windows\\system32\\)?cmd\.exe"? /c (ipconfig /all|ver|uname -i)|ipconfig +/all)\s*$' OR CommandLine REGEXP '(?i)^cmd\.exe /c bin\\MigrateV7\.bat >\.\\MigrateV7\.log\s*$' OR CommandLine REGEXP '(?i)^cmd\.exe /c ""[a-z]:\\program files( \(x86\))?\\ahsaycbs\\java\\bin\\java" -xm[^&|;]*$'), 0))))
title: Unexpected Child Process from AhsayCBS Service

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detects a cryptominer masquerading as Microsoft Edge, where an Edge-named binary carries the msedge_exe original file name or runs as a background daemon instead of a browser. Check for the MicrosoftEdgeUpdateSvc and EdgeUpdateHelper services and Taskgmr.ps1 in the temp directory.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName LIKE 'msedge\_exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\edge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%--daemonized%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Fake Edge Binary Launched with Daemonized Flag

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detects the use of a CMSTPLUA elevated COM Interface to execute a scripting interpreter to launch scripts or commands. Using this COM Interface bypasses UAC, and has been used by numerous threat actors to execute ransomware and other malware.
falsepositives: Some legitimate applications may use this occasionally
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%Processid:{3E5FC7F9-9A51-4367-9063-A120244FBEC7}%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName LIKE 'powershell\_ise.EXE' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Scripting Interpreter Execution Using CMSTPLUA COM Interface

author: Matt Anderson, Dray Agha, Anna Pham (Huntress)
description: Detects execution of the Kernel Driver Utility (KDU) tool. KDU can be used to bypass driver signature enforcement and load unsigned or malicious drivers into the Windows kernel, potentially allowing for privilege escalation, persistence, or evasion of security controls.
falsepositives: Legitimate driver development, testing, or administrative troubleshooting (e.g., enabling/disabling hardware)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\kdu.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='hamakaze.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-map %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-prv %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-dse %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-ps %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Kernel Driver Utility Execution

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detects ADNotificationManager.exe (Adobe Notification Manager) running from an unusual or unknown directory, which may be indicative of DLL Side-Loading. This binary has been observed being abused by multiple threat actors including GOLD BLADE to sideload malicious DLLs and deliver C2 payloads such as Havoc.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of ADNotificationManager.exe installed in custom directories
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='ADNotificationManager.exe' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ADNotificationManager.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Acrobat%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Reader%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Possible DLL Side-Loading Using ADNotificationManager.exe

author: Tanner Filip, Austin Worline, Chad Hudson, Matt Anderson
description: Detects Powershell spawned from Cleo software.  Evidence of unknown threat actor exploiting the CLEO tooling using this pattern observed in Dec 2024.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\javaw.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -NonInteractive%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -noni %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -EncodedCommand%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%VLTrader%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%lexicom%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%Harmony%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%VersaLex%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Possible Cleo MFT Exploitation 2024

author: Huntress Team
description: Detects suspicious process execution patterns associated with the exploitation of SolarWinds Web Help Desk (CVE-2025-40551, CVE-2025-40536, CVE-2025-26399). Identifies PowerShell spawned from Java/Tomcat processes in WHD directory executing BITS transfers or suspicious commands.
falsepositives: Legitimate administrative activity via SolarWinds WHD (should be rare)
Authorized software updates or maintenance scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WebHelpDesk\\bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\java.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\javaw.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%tomcat%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%bitsadmin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Start-BitsTransfer%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%certutil%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-RestMethod%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%iwr%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%irm%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%curl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wget%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Net.WebClient%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DownloadFile%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-EncodedCommand%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-Enc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%base64%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Exploitation - Uncommon Process Activity
